fusions.name: Killing Stoop
fusions.desc: A stooping strike on a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Downdraft
fusions.desc: Drives a column of wind down around you, dealing 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Take Wing
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a spot up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Gliding Focus
fusions.desc: Each stretch of ground you cover makes your next spell deal 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
